exceptions.scope: The workflow_run wakeup of the trusted native-review observer only
exceptions.reason: Both status arrival orders require a trusted completion wakeup. This observer performs no checkout or artifact execution. Exact creator, immutable receipt, current head, source/quality/merge outcomes and an initial-attempt fence precede the one review-job rerun.
exceptions.verification: Offline API-scenario tests reject wrong creators, stale heads, invalid receipts, failed quality, failed PR integration, unexpected jobs and repeated attempts.
exceptions.permission: actions:write is scoped to the reconciliation job; no source or status write permission is granted.
